attr.title: Diablo (DevilutionX)
attr.desc: DevilutionX 1.6.0-dev（Diablo 的源码级重制引擎）交叉编译成 aarch64，随包带引擎界面资源 assets/。游戏数据不在包内：正版 DIABDAT.MPQ 或免费分享版 spawn.mpq 由玩家自己放进 diablo/。
attr.inst: You must add your own game data to ports/diablo/: DIABDAT.MPQ from the retail game (e.g. the GOG release), or spawn.mpq from the free shareware version.
